description: Normalize audio loudness using the broadcast standard EBU R128 (loudnorm). Supports -16 LUFS (podcasts/Reels), -14 LUFS (YouTube), and optional voice clarity enhancement (80Hz high-pass to remove mic rumble). Works on audio or video files.

inputPath.description: Path to the source audio or video file.

outputPath.description: Destination path for the normalized media file.

targetLufs.description: Target integrated loudness in LUFS (-16 for podcasts/Reels, -14 for YouTube, -23 for broadcast). Default: -16.

targetPeakDb.description: Maximum allowed true peak level in dBTP. Default: -1.5.

voiceClarity.description: Apply speech enhancement filters (80Hz high-pass to remove mic rumble and gentle compressor for presence). Default: false.

name: normalize_audio
